evidence.source: Adam Khoo — Are the 3 Singapore Banks Cheap Enough? Buy DBS, UOB or OCBC? (2026-11-10)
evidence.claim: UOB is the only one of the 3 Singapore banks trading BELOW its P/B fair-value range after ~20% dip; ~4.7% ordinary-only dividend yield (no special dividends, buybacks instead). Reason it is cheap: slowest growth and lowest ROE of the three.
evidence.relation: below P/B fair value + dependable ordinary yield → Khoo sees relative value vs the other two
